summary: Appeals against conviction for offences under IPC including 302 (murder), 376A (rape of a child), 376(2)(i) (rape), and 201 (disappearance of evidence); POCSO Act, Sec 6; High Court of MP partly allowed the appeal and sustained other convictions with death sentence for 302 IPC; Supreme Court proceedings framed questions of law under Article 136 regarding circumstantial evidence and sentencing; final disposition not provided in the text.
